name: JSON to YAML
summary: Convert JSON to YAML instantly in your browser.
description: Paste JSON and get readable YAML. Objects, arrays, booleans, and numbers are preserved. Conversion runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: Is my JSON uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Does it support all JSON values?
faqs.answer: Yes for standard JSON. The output is plain YAML without exotic tags.

faqs.question: Can I convert YAML back to JSON?
faqs.answer: Yes — use the YAML to JSON tool.
